change: Call listen again on the bound socket with backlog 8192, subject to kernel cap.
evidence: Baseline full matrix was generator-ineligible in all workloads; fresh 4096 workloads recorded 4606 and 4575 failures across five rounds. Three independent restart suites passed.
hypothesis: The standard listener's small default accept backlog causes connection errors and >1 s tail latency when 4096 fresh clients connect together. Enlarging the listen backlog should reduce fresh-client failures.
next_action: Submit backlog-only challenger and compare the complete matrix.
verdict: Hypothesis, not yet tested; baseline performance inconclusive.
